func appendSubjectSuffix(subject, suffix string) string {
	switch {
	case strings.HasSuffix(subject, ".*"):
		return strings.TrimSuffix(subject, "*") + suffix
	case strings.HasSuffix(subject, ".>"):
		return strings.TrimSuffix(subject, ">") + suffix
	default:
		return subject + "." + suffix
	}
}
